---
title: Event Registration and RSVP Template
description: Copy-ready YAML template for registrations and RSVP flows with conditional follow-up steps.
---

Use this template when attendees need different follow-up questions based on how they plan to attend, while keeping a single registration flow.

## Full template

```yaml
version: 1
title: Event Registration and RSVP
description: Register attendees and collect RSVP details

sections:
  - id: section_1
    title: Registration
    fields:
      - id: attendee_name
        type: short_text
        label: Attendee name
        placeholder: Enter name
        validators:
          - required

      - id: attendee_email
        type: email
        label: Attendee email
        placeholder: name@example.com
        validators:
          - required

      - id: attendance_type
        type: single_select
        label: Attendance type
        options:
          - In Person
          - Virtual
          - Not Attending
        validators:
          - required

      - id: guests
        type: number
        label: Number of guests
        placeholder: 0
    next:
      - when: data.attendance_type == "In Person"
        go: section_2
      - when: data.attendance_type == "Virtual"
        go: section_3
      - else: done

  - id: section_2
    title: In-Person Details
    fields:
      - id: session_selection
        type: multiple_select
        label: Session selection
        options:
          - Morning session
          - Afternoon session
          - Networking session
        validators:
          - required

      - id: meal_preference
        type: dropdown
        label: Meal preference
        placeholder: Select option
        options:
          - No preference
          - Vegetarian
          - Vegan
          - Gluten free
    next: section_4

  - id: section_3
    title: Virtual Details
    fields:
      - id: timezone
        type: dropdown
        label: Timezone
        placeholder: Select option
        options:
          - UTC
          - UTC-05:00
          - UTC+00:00
          - UTC+01:00
          - UTC+05:30
        validators:
          - required

      - id: virtual_platform_ack
        type: single_select
        label: Platform acknowledgement
        options:
          - Yes
          - No
        validators:
          - required
    next: section_4

  - id: section_4
    title: Final Details
    fields:
      - id: notes
        type: long_text
        label: Notes
        placeholder: Add any notes

      - id: updates_opt_in
        type: single_select
        label: Receive event updates
        options:
          - Yes
          - No
        validators:
          - required
    next: https://example.com/events/confirmation

# Optional registration window.
# start_date: 2030-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
# end_date: 2030-01-31T23:59:59.999Z

# Optional custom completion screen (use this if you replace the redirect with `next: done`).
# completion:
#   title: Registration received
#   message: Your RSVP was submitted.
#   button:
#     label: View event page
#     url: https://example.com/events

# Optional notifications.
# connections:
#   - type: email
#     to: events@example.com
#     subject: "New RSVP - {{form.title}}"
#     include_responses: true
#
#   - type: webhook
#     url: https://example.com/webhook/rsvp
#
# Optional localization setup (add localized strings to titles/labels when needed).
# locale: en
```

## Customize this template

Change `attendance_type` values and the rule order in `section_1.next` to reflect your event flow. The first matching rule wins, so keep the most specific routing cases at the top of the list.

Choose either an external redirect or an in-form completion screen for the final step. The template uses an HTTPS redirect by default, and the commented `completion` block shows the alternative when you prefer `next: done`.

If your event does not require separate in-person and virtual questions, collapse `section_2` and `section_3` into a single follow-up section and point `section_1.next` directly to it.
